hooks.text: Up to twenty-five hundred people vanished in a single fiery night.
How did the deadliest wildfire in American history get forgotten?
Hurricane force winds turned Wisconsin lumber towns into raging firestorms.

title: Why History Forgot America's Deadliest Wildfire 😳
description: Discover the true story of the 1871 Peshtigo fire, the deadliest wildfire in American history that was overshadowed by the Great Chicago Fire.

beats.text: Up to twenty-five hundred people vanished in a single fiery night.
